rationale.problem_value: The user reports decay outperforming the existing entropy adaptive controller and selected a replacement that measures actual reference response. This report motivates development, not a newly verified outcome.
rationale.mathematical_consequence: Full-spectrum constrained gains replace one entropy-selected scalar with signed fit feedback and measured output KL, with explicit identity fallback and actual folded-model acceptance.
rationale.closest_work_delta: The source-screen disposition is a user-requested adaptation of established ideas, not a novel-method claim. The existing SPECTRUM estimator/generation/SFT contract is directly pinned; literature coverage gaps remain explicit in source-screen.json.
rationale.distinguishing_prediction: Identical spectral entropy no longer forces the same controller decision. Every deployed nonidentity operator must retain actual fit/guard/KL acceptance, while native recursive improvement remains falsifiable.
rationale.feasibility_and_cost: No model-weight optimization is added during calibration, but full gains require model backward passes and repeated fit/probe forwards. Eight native probes of at most 128 tokens, finite iterations and backtracking bound work; 4090 feasibility is unmeasured. This one candidate is the complete user-scoped pool, so no fictional reserve ranking or optimality among unexamined methods is claimed.
